name: DAVE
description: DAVE (Diagnostic Audio Visual Evaluation) is a benchmark dataset designed to systematically evaluate audio-visual models by ensuring both auditory and visual modalities are necessary for correct answers. It decouples evaluation into atomic subcategories to diagnose model weaknesses in visual understanding, audio interpretation, and audio-visual alignment.
reputation: A recent diagnostic audio-visual benchmark that is gaining attention for testing whether models truly use both modalities.
notes: Addresses visual bias in audio-visual benchmarks and provides fine-grained diagnostic categories.
